{{Quote|Stop them, they're fighting!|Sy Snootles speaking to this guard|<ref name="Hunt for Ziro">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>}}
This '''Gamorrean''' resided in [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt's Palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the events of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
When [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro the Hutt]] was imprisoned by the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] inside [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt's Palace]], this [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] along with [[Unidentified Gamorrean (Gardulla) 1|two]] [[Unidentified Gamorrean (Gardulla) 2|others]] were tasked with guarding his cell. After [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] learned of Ziro's whereabouts, she went to the prison and, in order to get past the guards, convinced two of them that [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]] requested to see which one of them is the stronger, so they started fighting. Snootles then told this guard to break up the fight between those two, and all three guard fought to the death. Their bodies were later found by the Hutt Grand Council.
